subject: Vendor Enrollment + PO format requirements for TrueGrove Media
messages:
From: Jacob Voss <j.voss@truegrove.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounting@truegrove.com
Date: 2028-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup / PO format + tax docs needed

Hi Ben,

We're getting Redwood set up in our AP system in advance of the PO for the Q4 integration work. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of things so our AP team can create the vendor record and accept invoices without manual hold. Can you confirm the following?

- Legal entity name (exact) to use for vendor record
- Remit-to (bank ACH details or EFT instructions) — our portal requires a bank name, account number last 4, and beneficiary name
- Tax docs: are you a US entity (W-9) or do you have EU VAT registration that should be used for invoices to our EMEA entity?
- PO reference format: we need to ensure Redwood invoices can include a PO number in format TG-##### (five digits) to match our matching rules. Do you require any specific PO field or invoice metadata?
- Preferred invoice file format (PDF preferred, will accept XLSX for CSV extracts) and an example filename convention for automation

Procurement attached the portal onboarding checklist; accounting will want something that maps to our vendor portal fields. If you can return the onboarding packet and tax evidence, we can get the vendor activated within 3 business days.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Jacob Voss
Senior Procurement Manager
TrueGrove Media

Attachments: TG_vendor_onboard_checklist.pdf (portal field list)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Voss <j.voss@truegrove.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO format + tax docs needed

Jacob — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Monica (Finance ops) to provide bank proof and Laura (Revenue Ops) for the PO/invoice format details. Answers below and I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice template.

Quick answers:
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (please use exactly as written)
- Remit: We can accept ACH (US) and wire. For vendor portal you can enter: Bank: Crescent Bank; Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Account last 4: 4321. Full account routing will be attached as an ACH setup PDF for your AP team.
- Tax docs: Redwood is a US entity. Attached is a signed W-9. For EMEA billing, we bill the local entity TrueGrove EMEA via intercompany arrangements — we'll provide a VAT certificate if you need that on EMEA invoices.
- PO reference format: TG-##### is fine. To ensure 1:1 matching, please make sure the PO number is present in the invoice metadata field called "PO Number" and also included in the invoice filename (e.g., invoice_TG-12345_Redwood.pdf). We also include our internal billing code (RWI-###) in the invoice body for your cross-reference but not required for AP matching.
- Invoice format: PDF/A preferred; we can also provide a line-level CSV if you require automated ingestion. Sample filename convention attached.

Attachments included: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_invoice_template.xlsx, W-9_redwood_signed.pdf

Monica / Laura — can you confirm whether we need to provide a voided check or bank letter for Crescent Bank for their portal? I can prepare and upload today.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jacob Voss <j.voss@truegrove.com>
Date: 2028-09-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO format + tax docs needed

Ben — quick internal note and confirmation back to Jacob.

Internal: For US ACH we will attach an ACH authorization pdf and a bank letter. I'll redact full account numbers before sending to TrueGrove portal per our security policy; portal requires last 4 and a bank letter signed by bank rep — we can request the letter from Crescent Bank today.

To Jacob / TG AP: we can provide a voided check image or bank letter. Please confirm which the portal requires (some portals only accept bank letters). Also confirm whether your portal expects an initial invoice to be marked as "test" for the first run.

One more note: our invoices will include both the "PO Number" field and our Billing Code (RWI-###) on line 1. If your matching tolerances only match by PO, that's fine — include both on your copy.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@truegrove.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Voss <j.voss@truegrove.com>, accounting@truegrove.com
Date: 2028-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / PO format + tax docs needed

Ben / Monica / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We completed the portal fields for Redwood Inference, Inc. and uploaded the following documents to our vendor record: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, W-9_redwood_signed.pdf, sample_invoice_template.xlsx.

A few items from AP follow-up: 
- Portal accepts bank letter OR voided check. To avoid delays we accepted the uploaded voided check image (uploaded today) and set bank last4 to 4321 — your vendor is in pending status until our risk team reviews the bank letter; if you can upload the bank letter we will clear the pending flag faster.
- For EMEA billing: please send EU VAT certificate if you intend to invoice our EMEA entity directly. Otherwise mark invoices to our US contract and we will route intercompany.
- PO handling: We validated TG-##### as the PO pattern. One small wrinkle — our AR system strips dashes for matching (TG12345). To be safe please put both formats on the invoice (TG-12345 and TG12345) in the "PO Number" field.
- First invoice: please append the text "First Invoice - Vendor Validation" in the invoice memo field so our team recognizes this as the initial payment. After validation we will change your status to Active; payment terms per the PO will apply (Net 45 unless otherwise stated).

Final step: sign the attached vendor agreement via DocuSign and confirm whether Redwood accepts early pay (we offer 1.5% for payment within 10 days). If yes, we will include the early-pay option on the PO.

Document: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Gv-TrueGroveOnboard (portal intake tracker)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/00/Envelopes/ABC12345-TrueGrove-VendorAgreement

Thanks — once we have the bank letter and signed agreement we'll flip you to Active and schedule the initial PO.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
AP Manager, TrueGrove Media

Appreciate the fast review, Lena. We'll upload the bank letter from Crescent Bank this afternoon and sign via DocuSign. A couple of clarifications so your AP team has everything they asked for: 

- We'll include both TG-12345 and TG12345 in the invoice PO field and in the filename for redundancy (invoice_TG-12345_TG12345_Redwood.pdf).
- Our billing system will mark the first invoice memo as "First Invoice - Vendor Validation" as requested.
- Regarding early pay: Redwood can accept early payment; we use a third-party early-pay vendor and can agree to 1.5% discount for 10-day payment. If TrueGrove would like to opt in, please indicate when you send the PO and we'll ensure the invoice includes the early-pay opt-in clause.

Next steps we will take today: upload bank letter (bank_letter_crescent_signed.pdf) to your portal, execute DocuSign vendor agreement, confirm ACH setup with Monica. Expect a final confirmation email once Active.

Thanks — looking forward to the PO.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
